d.title: One Piece Movie 03: Chinjuu-jima no Chopper Oukoku
d.en: One Piece: Chopper Kingdom of Strange Animal Island
d.jp: ワンピース 珍獣島のチョッパー王国
syn: One Piece: Chinjou Shima no Chopper Oukoku
d.synopsis: The crew comes upon Crown Island where the animals can talk and they makes Chopper their new king. But there are human hunters there also looking for the legendary horns that will give the person who consumes it immense power. Luffy and friends must stop them from destroying this animal kingdom.
